test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question: For making a toy, a hemisphere is attached at one end of a cylinder and a cone is attached at the other end of the cylinder. The cylinder, the cone and the hemisphere have a common radius of 4.2 cm. The height of the cylinder and that of the cone is 7 cm. Find the volume (in cm³) of the toy. (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the cylinder, cone, and hemisphere (r) = 4.2 cm

Height of the cylinder (h꜀yₗ) = 7 cm

Height of the cone (h꜀ₒₙₑ) = 7 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder (V꜀yₗ) = πr²h꜀yₗ

Volume of cone (V꜀ₒₙₑ) = (1/3)πr²h꜀ₒₙₑ

Volume of hemisphere (Vₕₑₘᵢ) = (2/3)πr³

**Calculation:**

V꜀yₗ = π × (4.2)² × 7

⇒ V꜀yₗ = (22/7) × (4.2)² × 7

⇒ V꜀yₗ = 22 × 4.2 × 4.2

⇒ V꜀yₗ = 387.464 cm³

V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3) π × (4.2)² × 7

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3) × (22/7) × (4.2)² × 7

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3) × 22 × 4.2 × 4.2

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ = 129.155 cm³

Vₕₑₘᵢ = (2/3) π × (4.2)³

⇒ Vₕₑₘᵢ = (2/3) × (22/7) × (4.2)³

⇒ Vₕₑₘᵢ = (2/3) × 22 × 4.2 × 4.2 × 4.2 / 7

⇒ Vₕₑₘᵢ = 155.053 cm³

Total volume (Vₜₒₜₐₗ) = V꜀yₗ + V꜀ₒₙₑ + Vₕₑₘᵢ

⇒ Vₜₒₜₐₗ = 387.464 + 129.155 + 155.053

⇒ Vₜₒₜₐₗ = 672.672 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
